message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks lateral alignment for re-engaging the sole active opponent by reversing from eastbound separation into a sustained hard left turn and later descent while preserving speed and altitude advantage; this brings it near B0100’s latitude and slightly reduces their separation.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to complicate a missile intercept while preserving energy by using repeated steep banking turns and a controlled descent; B01001 remains behind and north in the same altitude corridor throughout, while A0200 changes its eastbound geometry without expending its remaining missile."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks lateral alignment for re-engaging the sole active opponent by reversing from eastbound separation into a sustained hard left turn and later descent while preserving speed and altitude advantage; this brings it near B0100’s latitude and slightly reduces their separation.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to complicate a missile intercept while preserving energy by using repeated steep banking turns and a controlled descent; B01001 remains behind and north in the same altitude corridor throughout, while A0200 changes its eastbound geometry without expending its remaining missile.
